simon-wright.text: (2022) Per a district release on his swearing-in, planned to advocate for programs to mitigate COVID-19 learning loss: "I want to help establish a vision for Covina-Valley and effectively and clearly convey that story to all members of our community."

source.title: California School News Report: Covina-Valley USD Board of Education Reorganizes, Welcomes New Board Members (district release, Dec. 2022)

notes: Incumbent Simon Wright (elected 2022): only a 2022 district swearing-in release found; no campaign site or 2026 statements. No public positions found for challenger Gary C. Rodriguez (a Gary C. Rodriguez served as C-VUSD board clerk in an earlier term per a district release, but identity with the 2026 'Retired Marine Sergeant' candidate is unconfirmed, so nothing is attributed).
